title: Anthropic IPO: $81 Billion Raised, Biggest Listing Ever #Shorts
description:
Anthropic went public on Nasdaq (ticker ANT) on 19 Nov 2026 after pricing its IPO at $83 a share - about $81 billion raised, ahead of SpaceX's ~$75 billion listing in June, at a valuation of about $1.5 trillion. Shares opened around 34% above the IPO price.

Sources (checked 20 Nov 2026):
- Anthropic, IPO pricing (official, 18 Nov 2026): https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-prices-initial-public-offering
- AP via PBS NewsHour: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/anthropic-prices-its-ipo-at-83-per-share-valuing-the-ai-giant-at-1-5-trillion
- ABC News: https://abcnews.com/Business/anthropic-announces-price-83-share-ipo/story?id=138245320
- ABC (Australia) markets live, 20 Nov 2026: https://abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/asx-markets-business-live-news-nov-20/107403768

Not investment advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations. Facts are from the sources above.
